en: Capacity Check for a New Trip
Payments In and Out by Week
Advisor: documents are overdue on a trip
Documents are overdue on {trip_id} for {client}. Please chase them today.
A passport for {traveller} on {trip_id} expires before the return date. Please speak to {client} today.
Hello, please draft the itinerary for {destination}: {nights} nights from {start_date}, {travellers} travellers. Client {client}.
Freelance: please send the voucher packs
Hello, please send the voucher pack for booking {confirmation} to {client} before {travel_date}.
Dear {col:trips.client}, this is your itinerary for {col:trips.destination}, from {col:trips.start_date} to {col:trips.end_date}, {col:trips.nights} nights for {col:trips.travellers} travellers.
Your plan has {col:trips.itin_days} days listed. Day 1: {col:trips.day1_activity} in {col:trips.day1_place}. Last day planned: {col:trips.last_activity}.

It rests on {col:trips.bookings_n} bookings. Please check every name, date and time against your documents and tell us at once if anything is wrong. Times and places can change; we will tell you if they do.
Travel requirements summary for a destination
Travel requirements summary of {set:company}, dated {today}. Destination: {col:requirements.destination}.

Passport: we plan for a passport valid for {col:requirements.passport_months} months after the return date. Visa or entry permit: we allow {col:requirements.visa_days} days for any application, so documents are needed {col:requirements.lead_days} days before travel.
This is a planning summary reviewed on {col:requirements.reviewed_on}. Entry, passport and visa rules change: always check the destination's current rules from an official source before you travel.
Document checklist of {set:company}, dated {today}. Trip {col:trips.trip_id} to {col:trips.destination}.

Dear {col:trips.client}, to travel on {col:trips.start_date} we still need {col:trips.docs_missing} documents from you. Please send them as soon as you can and no later than {set:ready_days} days before you leave.

Please check the names on every document match the passports, that each passport is valid for the time the destination asks, and that your insurance covers the whole trip. Check the destination's current rules for passports, visas and health.
Reply with a photo or scan of each item. Your advisor is {col:trips.advisor}.
Voucher and confirmation pack cover sheet

Dear {col:trips.client}, this pack holds the vouchers, tickets and confirmations for {col:trips.destination}, {col:trips.start_date} to {col:trips.end_date}. It covers {col:trips.bookings_n} bookings; {col:trips.vouchers_open} are still to be sent and will follow.
Please keep a printed copy and a copy on your phone. Show the right voucher at each check-in. If a name or date looks wrong, call us before you travel.

Dear {col:briefings.client}, your briefing for {col:briefings.destination} is on {col:briefings.date}, {col:briefings.days_before} days before you leave. We will go through your itinerary, documents, payments, local contacts and what to do if plans change.
Please bring your questions and your documents. After the briefing we will send the notes and check that you have everything.
Emergency contact card for the trip
Emergency contact card of {set:company}. Trip {col:emergency.trip_id}, {col:emergency.destination}, for {col:emergency.client}. Departure {col:emergency.start}.
Local contact: {col:emergency.local_contact}, phone {col:emergency.local_phone}. Hotel: {col:emergency.hotel}. Supplier desk: {col:emergency.desk_phone}.
The destination is {col:emergency.hours_diff} hours from our own time zone. Call us first if plans change, then the local contact. Your advisor can be reached on {col:emergency.advisor_phone}.
In an emergency call the local emergency number first.
Packing and weather note of {set:company}, dated {today}. Destination: {col:packing.destination}, {col:packing.season} season.
Typical temperatures run from {col:packing.temp_low} to {col:packing.temp_high} degrees, with about {col:packing.rain_days} rain days in a month. {col:packing.note}.
These are planning figures only. Please check a current forecast a few days before you leave, and check your airline baggage allowance.
Insurance summary of {set:company}, dated {today}. Policy {col:insurance.policy_no} for trip {col:insurance.trip_id}.

Dear {col:insurance.client}, your insurer is {col:insurance.insurer}. Cover runs from {col:insurance.cover_start} to {col:insurance.cover_end}, {col:insurance.days_covered} days. Your trip runs from {col:insurance.trip_start} to {col:insurance.trip_end}.
Cover check: {col:insurance.gap_flag}. The premium is {col:insurance.premium}. Please read the policy terms for what is and is not covered, and keep the claim phone number with you.
Disruption notice of {set:company}, dated {today}. Reference {col:disruptions.disruption_id}, trip {col:disruptions.trip_id}.
Dear {col:disruptions.client}, a disruption affected your trip on {col:disruptions.date}. New plan: {col:disruptions.new_plan}.

The extra cost is {col:disruptions.extra_cost}. The supplier refunded {col:disruptions.supplier_refund}. You pay {col:disruptions.client_pays}. We are sorry for the trouble and will keep helping until you are settled.

Dear {col:trips.client}, welcome home from {col:trips.destination}. We hope your {col:trips.nights} nights went well. We would like to know what you enjoyed, what we could do better and if anything went wrong.
If you were happy, a short review would help us a lot, and we would be glad to plan your next trip. Your advisor is {col:trips.advisor}.

Open Start and type your company name and your own limits in the yellow cells: days before departure for documents, itinerary, vouchers and briefing, passport months, support hours and your time zone.
Check Team, Clients, Suppliers and Trips. They hold the people, clients, suppliers and trips that every other sheet looks up.

Fill Travel Requirements with your own planning notes for each destination: passport months, days to allow for a visa, health and insurance notes. Always check the destination's current rules from an official source.
Log every booking on Bookings and every document on Travel Documents. Days to the deadline, days early and the risk check fill in; Departures by Week shows which weeks are at risk.
Record each traveller on Passport and Visa Checks and each policy on Insurance Policies. Months valid after the return, the apply-by date and cover gaps are checked for you.
Build the plan on Itinerary Days and track every voucher on Vouchers and E-tickets until it reaches the client.
Keep Pre-departure Tasks, Pre-departure Briefings, Special Requests and Emergency Contacts up to date as a trip gets close.
Use Support Log and Disruptions and Rebookings while a trip is in progress, and Post-trip Tasks when the client is home.
Keep Packing and Weather Notes for the places you sell most and check a current forecast before you send one.
Use the 14 calculators for deadlines, passports, visas, itineraries, readiness, insurance, time zones, connections, checklists, requests, disruptions, packing, leave and a what-if.
Read the Departure Dashboard and Charts every week: departures, documents missing, passports, visas, vouchers, requests, support cases and ready rate.
Run group trips with every traveller, room and payment in one place
Place every traveller, room and payment of a group trip
Rooming list builder with missing names
travellers, preferences and room types give the rooms to list, the travellers still without a room and the singles supplement
every group shows days to the rooming deadline, travellers placed and travellers missing, and turns red when time runs short
rooms held, rooms picked up and the release date show how many rooms to hand back before the hotel charges for them
Group price per person with free places
net cost, mark-up, fee and leader free places become a price per paying traveller and a margin per traveller
instalments, amounts paid, days late and the balance of every traveller, with a statement to print
minimum numbers, travellers ready and penalty share show the penalty at risk before each cut-off date
supplier rates and net prices give commission, host agency share, advisor payout and margin per traveller
needs by kind, special meals to order and suppliers that still have to be told, for each group
the last free change day, supplier and ticket fees and what the new traveller owes
free places, upgrades and gifts against the group margin, so a leader benefit never eats the profit
Mark-up on supplier net price for group bookings you collect
Days ahead to warn of a deadline, a payment or a document
Wanted margin on the supplier net price of a group
Wanted margin per traveller on a group
Paying travellers for each free leader place
Rooms to keep spare in a block before releasing the rest
Days after the due date before a payment is late
Share of a group to confirm by the last cut-off
Group trips with rooming deadline and payments
One row per group trip: leader, dates, size, price per person and rooming deadline; travellers placed and missing, the deadline countdown, room counts and money collected fill in by themselves.
Travellers with room, passport, needs and balance
One row per traveller in a group: room, roommate, passport, dietary need, age band and money paid; whether they are placed, the balance owed and the passport check fill in by themselves.
Rooming list, one line for each room
One line per room: who sleeps in which room and the bed set-up; occupants against the beds in the room, the hotel and its phone fill in by themselves.
Room blocks held with the hotel
One row per room type held for a group: rooms held, the date the hotel takes them back and the rate; rooms used, rooms free and rooms to release fill in by themselves.
Group payments by traveller and instalment
One row per instalment a traveller owes: due date, amount and the date it was paid; paid or not, days late, the payment check and the traveller phone fill in by themselves.
Payment plan steps for each group
One row per instalment step of a group: due date and share of the price; the amount per person, the total expected and the amount collected so far fill in by themselves.
One row per cut-off date in the supplier contract: the minimum numbers and the penalty share; travellers ready, travellers short and the penalty at risk fill in by themselves.
Group price build-up and margin per traveller
One row per group: total price, supplier net price, expected commission and service fee; margin, margin per traveller and the check against your target fill in by themselves.
Supplier bookings for the group trips
One row per supplier booking of a group trip: gross price, commission, deposit and final payment; days to the final payment, what is still unpaid and the deadline check fill in by themselves.
Passports, insurance and forms by traveller
One row per document a traveller must hand in: kind, status and due date; the traveller name and phone, days to due and the document check fill in by themselves.
Dietary and access needs told to suppliers
One row per need: the traveller, the need and the date the hotel or supplier was told; the traveller name, the group and whether the supplier knows fill in by themselves.
One row per group: how many paying travellers earn a free place, the places used and the benefits given; places earned, places left and the value fill in by themselves.
Group tasks with owner and due date
One row per task of a group: what, who and the due date, and the day it was done; days overdue, the task check and the owner phone fill in by themselves.
Flights, transfers and coaches for each group
One row per flight, transfer or coach: date, time, supplier, travellers and seats in each vehicle; vehicles needed and spare seats fill in by themselves.
Excursions, tickets and meals for each group
One row per excursion or group meal: day, item, supplier and price per person; the date, the group size and the total cost fill in by themselves.
One row per supplier that serves your groups: the contact, the phone and the group desk; the group bookings and the gross booked fill in by themselves.
Group enquiries and days to sign
One row per group enquiry: leader, size, destination, travel window and budget; budget per person, days to a signed group and the open check fill in by themselves.
One row per client or group leader with the phone, e-mail and stage; the groups led and the group sales fill in by themselves.
One row per team member: role, phone, hours and advisor share; open group tasks fill in by themselves.
Groups running by month with payments received
One row per month: groups running, travellers in them, group payments received and all business sales booked; the average group size fills in by itself.

Pick the group row, type how many travellers want a single room, one large bed, twin beds or a triple; see the travellers still without a room, the rooms to list and the singles supplement.
Travellers who want a single room
Pairs who want one large bed
Travellers placed in a room now
Room count and singles supplement for a group
Type the travellers, the share who want a single room and the nightly rates; see the rooms to book, what the singles cost over sharing and the extra for each single traveller.
Share who want a single room
Double or twin room rate per night
Supplement to charge each single traveller
Group price per person with free places and mark-up
Type the net cost per person, the free places, the mark-up and the service fee; see the price per paying traveller, what the free places add to it and your income and margin per traveller.
Hotels, tours and transfers net cost per person
Commission rate on the land arrangements

Type the group size, the rule, the price and the net cost of a place; see how many free places the group earns, what they cost and how much each paying traveller would carry.

Per-person payment schedule for a group
Type the price per person, the deposit share, the number of instalments after the deposit and the dates; see the deposit, each instalment, their due dates and the group totals.
Instalments after the deposit, the last is the final payment
Attrition cut-off check with penalty and pace needed
Type the cut-off date, the minimum numbers, the travellers ready and the penalty share; see the travellers short, the penalty at risk and how many travellers to confirm each week.
Minimum as a share of the group
Last confirmed number to avoid any penalty
Rooms to release from a hotel block
Type the rooms held, the rooms picked up, the travellers still to place and the release date; see the rooms to give back, their value and whether to release now.
Rooms needed for the travellers still to place
Cost of keeping the rooms unused
Vehicles needed and cost per traveller for a transfer
Type the travellers, the seats, the share of seats kept for luggage and the vehicle costs; see the vehicles needed, the empty seats and the cost per traveller of a coach against minibuses.
Seats kept free for luggage and the leader
Cost of a coach for the transfer
Cost of a minibus for the transfer
Group commission, shares and margin per traveller
Type the net price of hotels, tours, transfers and flights, the commission rates and the fee; see the client price, your commission, the host agency and advisor shares and the margin per traveller.
Agency share after the host agency
Net earnings, commission after the host agency plus the fee
Type the price, the add-ons, the fees, the credits, the amount paid and the refunds; see the total due, the balance, the share paid and the next instalment.
Add-ons such as a single supplement
Name change or substitution cost and deadline
Type the days before travel, the free change period, the supplier and airline fees and the amount the leaving traveller paid; see the cost, what the new traveller owes and the last free day.
Name changes are free until this many days before travel

Dietary and access needs of a group by kind
Pick the group row and type the meals served; see the travellers with each need, the special meals to order, the extra meal cost and how many suppliers still have to be told.
Extra cost of a special meal
Ground-floor rooms, wheelchair access and hearing support
Needs the supplier does not know yet
Leader free places and upgrades against the group margin
Type the group size, the free place rule, the net cost, the upgrade and the gift; see the free places, what the benefit costs you and its share of the group margin.
Margin you expect on the group
Value of the free places at the price
Margin per traveller for group size and price together
Type a group size, the price and net cost per person and the fee per traveller; see the margin per traveller after the free places. The grid tries group size and price together.
Gap to the wanted margin per traveller
Leader: your group quote is ready
Hello {leader}, your group quote for {name} is ready: {price_pp} per person for {size} travellers. Shall we go through it together?
Leader: the room block is held
Hello {leader}, the rooms for {name} are held until {rooming_deadline}. Please send the traveller names before then.
Leader: please send the traveller names
Hello {leader}, please send the names of all {size} travellers as on their passports by {rooming_deadline}. {placed} are in a room so far.
Leader: travellers still need a room
Hello {leader}, {missing} travellers in {name} still need a room. Who shares with whom? The rooming deadline is {rooming_deadline}.
Leader: the group payment is due
Hello {leader}, the {instalment} of {per_person} per traveller is due on {due_date}. Please remind the group.
Leader: the final group payment is due
Hello {leader}, the final payment for {name} is due on {final_due}. {overdue_n} payments are late now. Please remind your travellers.
Leader: your leader benefit is confirmed
Hello {leader}, your benefit for {group_name} is confirmed: {benefit}. Free places left to use: {left}.
Hello {leader}, the briefing for {name} is on {briefing_date}. We start on {start_date}. Please tell the group.
Leader: the group list is attached
Hello {leader}, the traveller list for {name} is ready: {size} travellers, {rooms_listed} rooms. Please check it and tell us any change.
Hello {traveller_name}, your payment of {amount} for {group_name} is due on {due_date}. Please tell us if you have a question.
Hello {traveller_name}, thank you: your payment of {amount} for {group_name} arrived on {paid_on}.
Hello {name}, we have you in a {room_type} room with {roommate} for {group_name}. Please confirm or tell us who you prefer.
Hello {name}, please send your passport details exactly as printed so we can finish the list for {group_name}.
Traveller: your final payment is due
Hello {traveller_name}, your {instalment} of {amount} was due on {due_date}. Please pay it now or tell us when you will.
Hello {name}, your trip documents for {group_name} are ready. Please check every name and date and keep copies.
Traveller: tell us your dietary needs
Hello {name}, please tell us about any dietary or access need before the rooming deadline so we can tell the hotel.
Hotel: please confirm the rooming list
Hello, please confirm room {room_no} ({room_type}) for {group_name}, arriving {start_date}: {traveller_one} and {traveller_two}.
Hello, for {group_name} please release {release_qty} {room_type} rooms from the block before {release_date}. Please confirm.
Hotel: a name change for a traveller
Hello, a name change for {group_name}: room {room_no} now has {traveller_one} and {traveller_two}. Please update the list.
Hello, please confirm the {kind} for {group_name} on {date} at {time} for {travellers} travellers, {vehicles} vehicles.
Owner: the rooming list is incomplete
The rooming list for {name} is incomplete: {missing} travellers have no room. Deadline {rooming_deadline}, {days_to_deadline} days left.
Owner: a group is below its minimum
The group {group_name} is {short} travellers short of the minimum of {min_numbers} at the cut-off on {cutoff_date}. Penalty at risk: {penalty_amount}.
Owner: a group payment is overdue
Owner: the weekly group report is ready
Weekly group report: {name} has {placed} of {size} travellers in a room and {overdue_n} payments late. Next deadline {rooming_deadline}.
Travellers without a room in {name}: {missing}. Please list them, find roommates and update the Rooming List before {rooming_deadline}.
{name} in {group_name} has a passport problem. Please contact the traveller and check the destination's current rules.
Hello, please chase the missing names for {name}: {missing} travellers have no room. Leader {leader}. Deadline {rooming_deadline}.
Hello, please prepare the document packs for {name}, {size} travellers, start {start_date}. Check every name against the passports.
Rooming list from {set:company}, dated {today}, for the hotel {col:groups.hotel}.

Group: {col:groups.name}, led by {col:groups.leader}. Destination: {col:groups.destination}. Arrival: {col:groups.start_date}. Group size: {col:groups.size} travellers, {col:groups.placed} placed in a room so far.

Rooms on the list: {col:groups.rooms_listed}, of which {col:groups.rooms_double} double, {col:groups.rooms_twin} twin and {col:groups.rooms_single} single. The room-by-room list with the names is attached from the Rooming List sheet.
The deadline for this list was {col:groups.rooming_deadline}. Please confirm the rooms in writing and tell us at once if any room type is not available. Names are as on the passports.

Leader: {col:groups.leader}. Destination: {col:groups.destination}. Dates: from {col:groups.start_date}. Number of travellers: {col:groups.size}, of whom {col:groups.adults} adults, {col:groups.children} children and {col:groups.seniors} seniors.

Travellers with a dietary or access need: {col:groups.needs_total}. Travellers still without a room: {col:groups.missing}. The names, rooms and roommates are on the Travellers sheet and are shared only with the suppliers that need them.
Please check that every name is written exactly as in the passport and send changes before {col:groups.rooming_deadline}.
